title: Composition compatibility of abelian coefficient units
statement: Let $g:Z\to Y$ and $f:Y\to X$ be morphisms of schemes, and $M$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module. Let $\alpha_f(M):f^{-1}U_X(M)\to U_Y(f^*M)$ be the abelian adjunct of the module pullback unit [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison]. Choose the abelian composition isomorphism $c:g^{-1}f^{-1}\cong (f\circ g)^{-1}$ by Adjunction.leftAdjointCompIso for the pullback/pushforward adjunctions and the identity comparison on direct images. Let $t:g^*f^*M\cong(f\circ g)^*M$ be Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp. Then $U_Z(t)\circ\alpha_g(f^*M)\circ g^{-1}(\alpha_f(M))=\alpha_{f\circ g}(M)\circ c_{U_X(M)}$. No open-immersion or flatness hypothesis is required.

source.place: Functoriality of pullback and f-maps; pullbackUnit_comp_app, lines 43-56, and Mathlib Adjunction.leftAdjointCompIso.

proof.text: Apply the composite abelian pullback/pushforward hom equivalence to both sides. By homEquiv_naturality_left and homEquiv_naturality_right and the definition of coeff, the left adjunct is the composite of the two underlying module units followed by the pushforward of the underlying module composition comparison.

The conjugation identity unit_conjugateEquiv_symm for leftAdjointCompIso identifies the right adjunct with the underlying module unit for f composed with g. On each open these adjuncts agree by pullbackUnit_comp_app followed by the module comparison and its inverse; direct-image composition is the identity on sections. Sheaf morphism extensionality and injectivity of the abelian hom equivalence finish the proof.

theorem coefficientUnit_comp (g : Z ⟶ Y) (f : Y ⟶ X) (M : X.Modules) :
    (invImage g).map (coefficientUnit f M) ≫
        coefficientUnit g ((pullback f).obj M) ≫
        (SheafOfModules.toSheaf Z.ringCatSheaf).map ((pullbackComp g f).hom.app M) =
      (invImageComp g f).hom.app ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).obj M) ≫
        coefficientUnit (g ≫ f) M
